observations.text: Why avoid submitting this? The short input H1000000000 needs a billion H entries. Let n be input length, A the total number of fully expanded atoms, and d the maximum parenthesis nesting depth; without parentheses, d = 0. The baseline uses up to O(n + A·(d+1)) time and O(n + A) space before sorting. Even at d = 0, building and tallying A entries takes O(A) time; each parenthesis level may copy these entries again. For example, (H2O)3 has d = 1 and A = 9: build the child’s 3 entries, then copy them into 9 base-level entries and tally them. Copying depends on the expanded size, not just n. A count table stores H:1000000000 instead of a billion copies.

为什么不用它提交？短字符串 H1000000000 就要存十亿个 H。令 n 为输入字符数、A 为完全展开后的原子总数，d 为圆括号的最大嵌套深度；没有括号时 d = 0。基线最多花 O(n + A·(d+1)) 时间及 O(n + A) 空间（不含排序）。即使 d = 0，构建并统计 A 个条目也要 O(A) 时间；每层括号还可能再复制这些条目。例如 (H2O)3 的 d = 1、A = 9：先构建子组的 3 个条目，再在底层复制为 9 个并统计。复制开销取决于展开数量，而不只是 n。计数表只存 H:1000000000，不存十亿个副本。
